doc.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024

title: Joe Williams and the year with Basie
summary: A year of festivals with Basie and Joe Williams, leaving over low pay; Williams helped start the archive.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Yeah. Well I appreciate you for asking me all these questions you know. And I see that you’ve got Joe Williams on your wall there.
That’s right. Did you get to play behind him with the Basie band?

You know when I was with the Basie band. I joined, I’d been with them for a year. In that year we did every music festival in the world I think. I don’t think we missed one, there was Montreux, the North Sea, and in Japan. Joe Williams did most of them. We did the Norman Granz tour. And I was fortunate to be on all of those records — I mean all those festivals with Count Basie. But I had to leave because they weren’t paying much money you know. But yeah, I got to know Joe Williams real good. He was a good friend of mine.
He’s a good friend of this college. He actually helped get this interview project started back in 1995.
Yes. And the band played here with him in ’96 and your friend Bill Hughes was on the band of course at that time. What a guy.
Yeah, yeah, lot of memories. Lot of memories.
